_doc: Bowmaster line (spec #332, ticket B2 #334): an empty skeleton. Each Bowmaster skill ticket (B7-B11) appends its own definitions in its own marked region; until a key is defined, the job's pool entry for it is inert (never offered, never learned). Shared keys with Bowman (arrow_blow, bow_double_shot, arrow_bomb) stay in skills/bowman.json until B7 moves them here.

hurricane._b10_342: Bowmaster B10 #342 (Hurricane). Tier A: WZ damage 51 -> 100, own 10-frame ball, hit/0, Use and Hit sounds, one monster per arrow (no mobCount/attackCount). Tier C (GAME_DESIGN 7.45): burst rule, 12 arrows at 0.1 s after a 0.4 s wind-up, 6 s cooldown, range 450, 900 px/s, radius 6, eight survivor ranks on levels 4/8/12/15/19/23/27/30, the held bow's shooting stance for the whole stream, rarity bonuses; `capture_delay` 0.9 makes the playtest's first-cast screenshot sample the stream in flight (art only).
hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: Looses a long stream of arrows at the nearest monster while you keep moving.
